principles: Do not optimize for the sake of optimization.
Preserve logic and evidence ownership consistency.
drivers: Unblock B-9d6c DONE without mixing unrelated dirty assets into its implementation.
Preserve valid Lattice proof artifacts while removing stale pollution only when verified.
Keep host-neutral and non-authority boundaries clear.

options.name: A: Audit then commit valid main dirty assets as a separate reconciliation commit
pros: Produces an inspectable history for dirty asset ownership.
cons: May commit stale artifacts if the audit is shallow.

options.name: B: Restore all main dirty changes to unblock B-9d6c quickly
pros: Fastest path to a clean main.
Avoids committing stale or noisy artifacts.
cons: Violates the user request for audited handling if done blindly.

options.name: C: Stash all main dirty changes temporarily
pros: Quickly unblocks B-9d6c DONE without deleting data.
cons: Easy to forget and reintroduce stale pollution later.

chosen: A: Audit then commit valid main dirty assets as a separate reconciliation commit
rationale: Choose audited reconciliation because the dirty set includes Lattice proof artifacts and decision docs. The user explicitly wants host-reviewed correctness handling, not blind cleanup. If audit proves a group is stale scratch, restore that group only with explicit evidence.

preMortem.scenario: Stale baseline artifacts are committed as formal proof assets.
preMortem.trigger: Two-host audit only checks filenames and not report freshness or claim boundaries.
preMortem.consequence: Future Layer 2/3 claim evaluation may be polluted or misleading.
preMortem.mitigation: Require Claude and Codex audit summaries to classify artifacts as valid, stale, duplicate, or deferred before commit.

preMortem.scenario: A useful untracked decision doc is deleted while cleaning main.
preMortem.trigger: Cleanup treats all untracked docs as duplicate noise.
preMortem.consequence: Accepted planning context is lost and future readers cannot reconstruct the decision.
preMortem.mitigation: Compare untracked docs against existing/worktree versions and only remove exact duplicates or explicitly stale drafts.

preMortem.scenario: B-d925 hides main cleanup inside B-9d6c or another story.
preMortem.trigger: DONE is retried after arbitrary manual changes without separate evidence.
preMortem.consequence: B-9d6c history gains unrelated changes or the cleanup becomes unauditable.
preMortem.mitigation: Keep B-9d6c frozen; record cleanup findings/evidence under B-d925 and commit main reconciliation separately.
